[Thinking]
**Considering PvE endgame options**

I need to provide a subjective answer about the best PvE endgame builds. It definitely depends on the player’s playstyle, so I’ll mention that. Some popular builds I might include are quality builds, pyro, dex, str, and sorcery. If we're talking about the "best," I might throw in GiantDad, especially in relation to the PvP meta. It’s important to keep the answer concise but informative!
[/Thinking]

The “best” endgame build in **Dark Souls Remastered** depends on whether you mean **PvE**, **PvP**, or “strongest/easiest overall.” For most players, the strongest all-around endgame build is a **Quality Pyromancer**: high HP/stamina, strong melee options, and pyromancy that needs no stat investment beyond attunement.

## Best all-around endgame build: Quality Pyromancer

### Recommended stats around SL 120
Starting class: **Pyromancer** is ideal.

- **Vitality:** 40–50  
- **Attunement:** 16–19  
- **Endurance:** 40  
- **Strength:** 27  
- **Dexterity:** 40  
- **Resistance:** Base, never level this  
- **Intelligence:** Base  
- **Faith:** Base  

Why 27 Strength? When two-handing, 27 STR effectively becomes 40 due to the 1.5x two-hand bonus.

## Best weapons

### Top melee options
- **Claymore +15** — amazing all-around, flexible moveset
- **Zweihander +15** — huge damage and stagger, very beginner-friendly
- **Uchigatana/Iaito +15** — great dex weapons with bleed
- **Balder Side Sword +15** — one of the best dex/quality weapons, if you can farm it
- **Great Scythe +15** — excellent range and damage

Use **Charcoal Pine Resin**, **Gold Pine Resin**, or buffs if your build supports them.

## Pyromancies
Pyromancy is extremely strong because it scales mostly from your **Pyromancy Flame upgrade level**, not Int or Faith.

Good spells:
- **Great Combustion**
- **Black Flame** if you have the DLC
- **Great Chaos Fireball**
- **Power Within**
- **Fire Tempest/Chaos Storm**

Upgrade your **Pyromancy Flame to +15**, then ascend it with Quelana and upgrade it further.

## Armor and rings

### Rings
- **Ring of Favor and Protection** — one of the best rings in the game
- **Havel’s Ring** — great for heavier armor
- **Dark Wood Grain Ring** — excellent if you want ninja flips, requires low equip load
- **Wolf Ring** — good for poise

### Armor
For PvE, use whatever keeps you under your desired roll threshold:

- **Fast roll:** under 25% equip load  
- **Medium roll:** under 50% equip load  
- **Fat roll:** avoid unless using a tank setup  

Strong armor pieces:
- **Giant’s Set**
- **Havel’s Set**
- **Black Iron Set**
- **Elite Knight Set**
- **Mask of the Mother/Child/Father**

## Simple “best” PvE setup
If you just want something powerful and easy:

- **Weapon:** Zweihander +15 or Claymore +15  
- **Shield:** Grass Crest Shield  
- **Armor:** Mix pieces to stay under 50% or 25% equip load  
- **Rings:** Ring of Favor and Protection + Havel’s Ring  
- **Pyromancy:** Great Combustion, Power Within, Great Chaos Fireball  
- **Stats:** 40 VIT, 40 END, 27 STR, 40 DEX  

This build can handle basically everything in NG and NG+.

## If you mean PvP meta
The iconic PvP/endgame meme build is **Giant Dad**:

- **Weapon:** Chaos Zweihander +5  
- **Armor:** Giant’s Set  
- **Mask:** Mask of the Father  
- **Rings:** Havel’s Ring + Ring of Favor and Protection  
- **Stats:** high Endurance, enough Strength to two-hand Zweihander, some Attunement for pyromancy  

It is strong, but for actual flexibility, a Quality Pyromancer is usually better.

**Bottom line:** For the best overall endgame build in Dark Souls Remastered, go **40 END, high VIT, 27 STR, 40 DEX, +15 Claymore/Zweihander, maxed Pyromancy Flame, and Ring of Favor and Protection + Havel’s Ring.**
